reader.requirement: At --std 85 a sum counter without RESET is set to zero when its own control footing is processed (also when that footing is SUPPRESSed); with RESET ON data-name-2 or FINAL it is set to zero when that control level is processed, whether or not a control footing is defined for the level; and INITIATE sets every sum counter to zero.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002: RESET ON may name the footing's own level (must not be lower, §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR4); from 2002 it must be higher

reader.edition-search: EndOfGroupSumReset, ProcessControlFootings and Initiate read no edition (grep Edition|DialectBehavior in ReportWriter.cs)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: RESET ON the footing's own control is accepted at 85 and behaves as the default reset (p6c), refused at 2023 (COBOL6824)

reader.notes: A counter with no RESET carries level -1 and is reset at the end of its own group's processing (EndOfGroupSumReset, reached also from BeginGroup for a suppressed group); a RESET level is reset in ProcessControlFootings for every level from minor to the break, declared footing or not. Classes a, d, e, f do not apply to reset timing.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR12, XIII.3.20.4 GR10b/10f and XIII.4.7.4 GR2. r6a: S2 in CF B with RESET ON A, rolled into S3 in CF A. CB printed 1, 3, 4 (no reset at B) and CA printed 4, 4, so the cumulative S2 rolls forward each time and resets at level A. After TERMINATE, S2 and S3 are 0 0. INITIATE, MOVE 50/60 to the counters, TERMINATE with no GENERATE left them 50 60: the TERMINATE did no CF processing and no reset, which XIII.4.7.4 GR2 requires. Class c (r6c): at 85, RESET ON FINAL in CF FINAL is accepted (not a lower level) and SUM in a DETAIL is refused COBOL6763 citing §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR3; at 2023, RESET ON FINAL is refused COBOL6824. Runs r6a-001, r6c-001, r6c-002. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR12  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR3  (3.19.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'.
